blurb: Ski Hut offers bike and ski rentals, sales of bikes and accessories, and maintenance and repair services. They provide a variety of bike and ski equipment including alpine touring ski bindings and bike accessories. Maintenance services include bike tune-ups, repairs, waxing, and binding mounting.
extraNote: Upon drop-off of bike an estimate on repairs will be given; actual bill may vary · One free tune-up within first 30 days of bike ownership · Bicycles left more than 30 days after completion of work subject to storage fee · Minimum $50 surcharge for warranty service on products not purchased at Ski Hut · 8550 Grand Avenue, Duluth MN
